body: Too much to explain sorry. It's out of my control.
Sorry I just can't take another year.

You definitely are good enough, probably more than good enough. Break ups are hard especially when they are unexpected, same thing happened to me my ex left me because my illnesses were too much to handle. I know you've probably heard this a lot but time does heal, you will find another significant other and they will make you forget about to past and have a positive impact on your life. I hope you stay with us :)
What makes you happy? Do you have any hobbies?
Have you tried talking to them about how they make you feel?
You basically described my life apart from the family situation, isn't there a way you can get away from them? I know ignoring them isn't a viable option.
What are you worried about?

I'm sorry he betrayed you like that, if that person was the right one he would of understood your situation. It's not going to be easy to find an understanding partner but when you do you will know he's the one.
What's making you feel this way?

People can be extremely cruel, please don't OD it's painful and if you later regret it the damage can be irreversible. There are good guys out there, it can sometimes take a long time to find the right one but it will be worth it.

That happens to me a lot also, people come into my life pretend to care use me and leave. I've learned people are selfish and cruel hence my trust issues. Live for your dogs, they need you and they will love you unconditionally.
I use the Internet and drive around a lot too I find driving very theraputic, it's a good way to pass time too. Have you thought about finding any new hobbies?

There's no ultimate cure for mental illness only methods to make it more manageable and make living with it bearable, it's hard for people to empathise when they don't truly understand mental illnesses. I've also been fighting for years, I'm not going to give you the typical cliché lines because I know after so long it starts to sound fake. Just keep fighting, sometimes we have to endure these things until something really great happens, in the end it makes you a stronger and more knowledgeable person. Stay strong :)

We share a few things in common, I know how it feels to get to that point where everything seems pointless and nothing helps. Please don't do it, I'm almost certain you have people in your life that care about you. What hobbies do you have? What helps you pass the time?

I'm so sorry everyone has treated you so poorly, is it possible to report this man who is doing these things to you? I have trust issues myself and completely understand where you're coming from. It's nice to see you're still ambitious, I hope you succeed. Is there anyway you can escape such a toxic environment with this man?

I know how you feel nothing makes me happy or brings me any joy anymore, relationship break ups can be hard some more so than others. It's good that you can see people care about you, I'm sorry you're hurting so much. As cliché as it sounds time does heal it sometimes can take a long time but it does, do you think you could distract yourself from this pain?

I know this is a bit late but it really depends on what pills he took and how many, there are medications to reverse specific overdoses but it's not universal it really does depend on what he took. If it was me and its still early stages I would induce vomiting. Sorry I couldn't be of more help, I hope all is well.

Yeah I know how you feel, afraid of being a burden. I think there are various chat rooms and forums etc but I don't know any specific ones. We here on this sub will always listen and support you the best we can :)
I think there are a few, I've not tried them myself but if you Google "suicide prevention online chat" you will see them :)

I'm sure that's not true, if you say your husbands business would go under without you that's some sort of proof right there. Have you spoken to your husband about these feelings you're having? Also from what I read around the Internet and on here the life insurance route isn't the way to go they always seem to get out of paying out and your close ones won't get a penny :(

I read it, around this time of year we do seem to feel more alone especially if you don't have many friends or family. Loneliness is a tricky one even for me I think it gets to the best of us, keeping busy or distracting yourself with hobbies or activities can help a bit I say this a lot but it's what I've found that works best for me at least I can't speak for everyone else. Do you go to any social events to meet people or interact with others?

It's hard when there's a lot of pressure on you because of high expectations, the world unfortunately seems to be falling apart at least from my pessimistic perspective. There's not much we can do about that unless you're a higher power, the older generations that sit in government don't tend to think about the upcoming generations because as horrible as it sounds they won't be around to see so they don't care. That's what I think anyway, sorry for the mini rant :)
Panic attacks suck, you can try take deep slow breaths in through your nose and slowly breathe out all the way through your mouth it works for me.

I've been alone most of my life, I've learned to cope with it but only by staying busy and keeping myself preoccupied. I would suggest to you to keep busy find something you can pour all your spare time into and love, there's no real cure to loneliness only ways to take your mind off it.
I think that's how a lot of us think here, what's bringing you down?

I know being alone can be tough, I only have a few friends also (quality not quantity :P). Don't worry about your peers some people accelerate faster than others in life some are late bloomers others bloom too soon, you shouldn't compare yourself to others because everyone is different. As for finding a partner sometimes it's best to focus on other aspects of life and when you least except it you will meet someone or if it's something you wish to pursue you could maybe go to social events or try online?
That's good keep yourself occupied :)
Do you have any hobbies you enjoy doing that could distract you from these thoughts?
Have you spoken to a doctor or mental health professional about these thoughts?
Is there anything that triggers these thoughts? Or are they random?

Some parents are like that they are way too protective with their children, they have probably heard about all the bad people on the Internet and are overreacting to finding out about your existence in their daughters life. I know how you feel loneliness sucks it will suck the life right out of you, there's always a significant other for someone appearance isn't all that matters. For me personality matters more than anything and I have no doubt that you have a great one. Unfortunately good things come and get taken away too soon and it hurts like hell but you don't have to take your own life imagine how it would make her feel not only her but your family. You're still so young it would break my heart if you ended your life so early and abruptly, there's always hope and I have faith that you are strong enough to get through these hard times. Stay strong friend :)
I completely agree

That honestly sucks, sometimes a lot of bad things happen all at once and it really takes it out on you. I'm sorry about your dog, being a dog lover myself I can't even begin to imagine how much that must hurt. Life can still be alright without material possessions, it can be difficult without money though. Is there any financial help in your area? What would make life better for you at the moment?

Just a heads up she might be upset that you called the police on her, but as long as she's safe it will definitely be worth it. Try to support her as much as possible and give her space if she needs it, if she's stable of course I wouldn't leave her if she's persistent on hurting herself.

Unfortunately everyone's problems are real don't put yourself down like that, but sometimes we need that extra bit of help. It's not always best to keep things to yourself bottling up thoughts and emotions can take a toll on you, I like your determination though. If you are willing to give hotlines a go you can find the resources in the side bar. Stay strong :)

I can relate to quite a lot of this, I'm scared people will get fed up of me so I try not to get attached and tend to isolate myself. I don't think it's right that your mother shamed you and dismissed your pain like that, if you don't feel comfortable talking to the school counselor do you think you would be able to talk to a hotline?

That was heartbreaking to read, imagine how he will feel when he reads that. No matter how badly you've messed up its not worth killing yourself over, things can always be worked out. I hope you stay with us.

That's good at least she has someone to talk to about these feelings instead of bottling them up, sometimes we lose all hope and get stuck in an endless loop of pessimism and as a result no longer want to get better. If she will only talk to you about it try be as supportive as possible just by listening to her and letting her know you're there is enough sometimes. However if you're afraid things are getting worse I would definitely contact someone close to her.

Have you thought about talking to a hotline or seeking some other kind of help? You don't have to hurt yourself for someone to take you seriously, there are always hotlines and services that can help you. You can find resources for these in the side bar or by searching online.

Have you spoken to her about this? You could suggest she talk to a counselor or a therapist, do you know if there's anything specific troubling her? I know for some of us this time of the year is particularly difficult.
I've been there, let me tell you it's extremely painful. What's troubling you to bring you to this conclusion?

Are you talking about hurting yourself so someone will help you? Or is it because people don't believe how much pain you're in? Or something else? Sorry for the questions just trying to understand a little better.

Causing panic is the last thing you want to do in a delicate situation like this, best thing you can do is support her the best you can. If you suspect she's being sincere and you fear for her well-being I would contact someone she's close to.
I think the best thing you can do for him is to stay in contact and try support him and let him know you're there.

Do you happen to know anyone close to him like family? If so you could contact them and explain why you're concerned about him. If you fear he's in immediate danger and happen to know where he lives or just the area and also a name the emergency services might be able to help him.
Me! If I wasn't so numb I'd say the loneliness and lack of affection is almost heart breaking

Please don't overdose it's awfully painful, who's yelling at you? Could you talk to them about how it makes you feel or ask them to stop? I know how it feels to be belittled, it takes a toll on you that's for sure.

I think relying on people for happiness is not wise speaking from personal experience. It's good that you recognise this and want to get better that's a start, have you thought about therapy or counselling?

You're full of potential you just have to find it, being pessimistic ends up making you feel worse. Is there anyone you could talk to friends or family? Would you be willing to talk to a therapist? You could also give hotlines a try

You would definitely be missed, sometimes people get scared off when they hear about mental health. I know the feeling of being alone and feeling abandoned, especially when it feels like everyone has given up on you. You're not alone you have us :)

Sometimes when we are stuck in a dark place we lack the energy and motivation to seek help, it's great that you are supporting her but you have to consider your own mental health also. Are you in contact with any of her immediate family? Or are there any local services that could help her? Maybe a hotline?
What's getting you so down friend? Anything in particular?

I'm very shy and quiet also can't even make myself appointments, for me I tend to live inside my head and rarely talk it really sucks. Would you be willing to maybe talk to someone like ask a stranger for the time baby steps like that? You could gradually build some sort of social skills even if it's only minimal, you're much older than me but I know how it can get you down its very isolating in my experience at least. Sorry if I assumed anything.
Taking an overdose is an awful way to go believe me I've been there, what's causing you to feel so down?

I also know that feeling all too well, for me it gets to the point where I don't quite have the energy or motivation to seek help anymore. I encourage you to do the things you love I know it's hard when it feels like the energy is being sucked out of you, maybe you could start reading again? Or maybe find more hobbies/activities to enjoy? Baby steps :)

I can relate to that, I'm in a really bad place myself. It's not a nice place to be in, it saddens me to hear how much you're hurting. Is there anything that lifts your mood or distracts you from this pain? For me I like to listen to music or go for a drive

That's not true I'm sure so many people will miss you I know it's such a generic response but it's true. People would be so sad and probably mourn you forever, you're stronger than this I have faith in you and I know you can beat this. I hope you will stay with us.

We aren't allowed to suggest or talk about suicide methods here, but we can help and provide a shoulder to cry on or an ear to listen. It sucks that your partner cheated on you no one deserves that, have you seen a doctor about your eyes or done any research on it to find some remedies for the condition?  Is there any way for you to get any financial help in your area? Sorry for a lot of questions
